description: NPC/monster roster - see CLAUDE.md's NPC (Monster) Actors section for authoring guidelines and the CR/stat formula. Generated by npm run generate:monsters into a real Actor-type compendium (src/packs/monsters -> packs/monsters), and also read directly by scripts/lib/level-gen/MonsterGenerator.mjs to auto-populate generated floors' rooms.

monsters.name: Bubbling Ooze
monsters.biography: A formless mass of half-finished reagent, still trying to become something.

monsters.name: Acid Blob
monsters.biography: Whatever container once held it is long since dissolved.

monsters.name: Failed Construct
monsters.biography: An early attempt at a servitor, abandoned before the animating formula was finished.

monsters.name: Azure Jelly
monsters.biography: Cold to the touch and unsettlingly patient - it remembers every shape it has ever worn.

monsters.name: Crystal Guardian
monsters.biography: Grown, not built - a lattice keyed to attack anything that isn't wearing the right sigil.

monsters.name: The Great Distillation
monsters.biography: The Alchemist's Guild's final formula, still brewing, still refusing to be finished.

monsters.name: Shambling Zombie
monsters.biography: Moves toward warmth and noise, in that order, without any real understanding of either.

monsters.name: Skeletal Warrior
monsters.biography: Still holds its old formation, decades after the rest of the garrison stopped answering roll call.

monsters.name: Crawling Corpse
monsters.biography: Too damaged to stand, not damaged enough to stop.

monsters.name: Ghoul
monsters.biography: Fast, hungry, and disturbingly aware of exactly where the party's blood is.

monsters.name: Wight
monsters.biography: Its grip drains warmth first, then strength, then the will to pull away.

monsters.name: Ancient Lich
monsters.biography: Died centuries ago and has been meticulously annoyed about it ever since.

monsters.name: Fire Vortex
monsters.biography: A small, hungry tear in the containment ward, still widening.

monsters.name: Ball Lightning
monsters.biography: Drifts along the path of least resistance, which is rarely the path anyone wants it to take.

monsters.name: Electric Golem
monsters.biography: Built to regulate a conduit that's since started regulating it instead.

monsters.name: Fire Elemental
monsters.biography: Bound here generations ago; the binding is the only thing keeping the floor above from burning.

monsters.name: Earth Elemental
monsters.biography: Moves like the floor itself decided to have an opinion.

monsters.name: The Unmoored Rift
monsters.biography: Not a creature so much as a wound in the world's foundations, still tearing wider.

monsters.name: Zealous Acolyte
monsters.biography: Believes completely, which makes it far more dangerous than it looks.

monsters.name: Cloaked Cultist
monsters.biography: Recites the same three verses whether greeting a new initiate or a trespasser.

monsters.name: Cherub Familiar
monsters.biography: Looks harmless. Reports everything it sees straight back to the inner sanctum.

monsters.name: High Priest
monsters.biography: Leads the rite personally when the stakes are high enough to warrant it.

monsters.name: Paladin of the Veiled Choir
monsters.biography: Genuinely believes it's defending something holy. It isn't, anymore.

monsters.name: The Hollow Star's Herald
monsters.biography: Speaks with the Hollow Star's certainty, and expects that certainty to be enough.

monsters.name: Warren Wolf
monsters.biography: Rarely hunts alone; if you can see one, at least two more can see you.

monsters.name: Giant Bat
monsters.biography: Nests in the ceiling and only drops when something below stops moving.

monsters.name: Cave Spider
monsters.biography: The web is easy to spot. The second one, strung to catch whoever ducks the first, is not.

monsters.name: Black Bear
monsters.biography: Claimed this den long before anyone drew a map of it.

monsters.name: Basilisk
monsters.biography: The statues nearby aren't decoration.

monsters.name: Matriarch Troll
monsters.biography: Every creature on this floor answers to her, and she answers to no one.

monsters.name: Lurking Horror
monsters.biography: Waits in the dark between torches for exactly as long as it takes to be forgotten.

monsters.name: Unseen Horror
monsters.biography: You will hear it before, during, and possibly after you see it.

monsters.name: Wretched Manes
monsters.biography: The least of whatever came through, and still more than most parties expect.

monsters.name: Apocalypse Crab
monsters.biography: Its shell has never once matched the last description of it.

monsters.name: Tentacled Starspawn
monsters.biography: Thinks in directions that don't exist in this floor's geometry.

monsters.name: The Starcursed Mass
monsters.biography: Predates the floor, the dungeon, and quite possibly the name anyone's given either.
